Date: Tue, 3 Jul 2028 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Demo request — Dedicated inference for EdgeCase

Hi Aisha,

We signed up through the self-serve flow and would like to schedule a walkthrough of Redwood Dedicated. A few details up-front so you can route the right folks:
- Workload: production conversational summarization + semantic search
- Peak throughput: ~300 qps sustained, bursts up to ~1,000 qps for a few minutes
- Typical sequence length: 200–400 tokens (avg ~256)
- Latency target: p95 under 200ms for generation (important); p50 < 80ms would be great
- Data: user-provided inputs (no PHI), retention policy required for audit logs

We're in evaluation and want to understand cost/latency tradeoffs, autoscale behavior, and what dedicated sizing looks like for our workload. Can someone from solutions and SDR schedule a 45–60 minute demo? We're flexible next week — prefer mornings PT.

Thanks,
Maya Kline
Head of Platform
EdgeCase Corp
maya@edgecase.ai

PS — HubSpot updated with deal id EC-4521 and some notes; happy to share a calendar invite.

Hi Maya — thanks for the context, this is a great fit for Redwood Dedicated. Quick tech intake to make the call productive:
- Is inference stateless (single-turn) or do you rely on KV cache across tokens? If stateful, what % of calls reuse context?
- Sequence length distribution (p50/p95) and tokenization (BPE/Unigram) helps with kernel selection.
- Tolerance for quantization (int8 / awq / fp16) — would you accept some quality loss to reduce cost?

Based on your initial numbers (300 qps sustained / 1k qps bursts / avg 256 tokens), rough sizing: 2–3 dedicated instances for sustained traffic with autoscale headroom for bursts; we'll validate during the demo. For latency, we typically validate p95 under your target via a short workload replay during the session.

I've attached a short pre-read (Dedicated-capacity-checklist.pdf) — please confirm those entries (model type, infra restrictions, compliance needs). Also sharing a prep folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-dedicated-prep

- Thu Jul 6 — 09:00–10:00

If none of these work, tell us a couple times and Neha will coordinate. Looking forward to it.

Best,
Ben Carter
